title: Warm Spiced Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: Tender beef empanadas filled with fermented beef, unsweetened cocoa, and spices, featuring sashimi-cut beef for a cozy Argentinian dish, ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly for a balanced meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, and unsweetened cocoa.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut out circles of dough.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the remaining egg and bake for 20 minutes.
